Daniel Sereno Fernadez

Devops Engineer

Automating the future, one pipeline at a time — empowering teams with efficient CI/CD workflows and intelligent infrastructure

Hello there👋, I am a DevOps Engineer focused on automation , continuous integration and efficient deployment pipelines. I have hands-on experience with tools like Jenkins , Docker , SonarQube , Artifactory and Bitbucket , creating CI/CD processes that streamline the software development lifecycle. I work primarily in AWS environments and I am currently pursuing AWS certifications to deepen my cloud experience. I'm passionate about infrastructure as code , observability and continuous improvement in cloud-native environments. I have a Master degree in Artificial Intelligence , a field I am passionate about.
